POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Power Purchase Agreement is between Mesa Wind Holdings LLC ("Seller") and Aldine Freight Co. ("Buyer").

1. Sale. Seller will sell and Buyer will buy all the energy produced by the 40 MW wind facility, for 15 years from the commercial operation date.

2. Price. The contract price is $34.00 per megawatt-hour, escalating 2% each year.

3. Delivery Point. Energy is delivered at the interconnection point with the transmission system.

4. Renewable Energy Credits. Seller will transfer to Buyer all renewable energy credits from the facility.
